text: A separate helmfile-like repo agents-helmfile in claude-code-tatara manages namespace agents, with a copied .env, and is applied by local mise tasks (lint, test, diff, apply).
The orchestrator gets a CNPG Postgres (agent-orchestrator-db) in namespace agents with the existing CNPG backup config.
The orchestrator is installed from its helm chart on namespace agents and exposed only to 192.168.1.0/24, with no auth, at agents.szymonrichert.pl.
Secrets (the Claude OAuth token copied from the existing secret, a generated master key) are SOPS-encrypted and never printed or committed unencrypted.
Every newly scheduled session starts with any-mcp preinstalled, proven by a smoke script (UI answers on the LAN, a 1-replica cluster yields a ready pod whose claude mcp list shows any-mcp).
